nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Starts when a workflow that uses this workflow as its error workflow fails.

nodes.name: Format Error Report
nodes.notes: Builds the email text and stores the report in Firebase logs/workflowErrors.

nodes.name: Send Error Email
nodes.notes: Sends the error report by email. Needs an SMTP credential (e.g. securesmtp.t-online.de, port 465, SSL) for the sender address.

parameters.content:
## Error handler
Catches every crash of the recipe workflow (Settings -> Error workflow points here), stores the report in Firebase logs/workflowErrors and emails it to alex.lindt@t-online.de.

Setup once: open **Send Error Email** and select an SMTP credential for the sender address.
